dedupe_keys.name: 3daerorelief the first 3d benchmark uav dataset for post disaster assessment

description: 3DAeroRelief: The first 3D Benchmark UAV Dataset for Post-Disaster Assessment is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Nhut Le et al. Timely assessment of structural damage informs disaster response and recovery. However, most prior work in natural disaster analysis relies on 2D imagery, which lacks depth, suffers from occlusions, and provides limited spatial context. 3D semantic segmentation offers a richer alternative, but existing 3D benchmarks focus mainly on urban or indoor scenes, with little attention to disaster-affected areas. Coverage: not stated; published in 2026. Formats: TXT, Point cloud, Python. The data are held in Kaggle and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support emergency-service and public-facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
